# Problem
Attempting to serialize an UdonSynced int array which has not been initialized fails, breaking the entire serialization attempt.
# The Deets
I've only tested this with intergers, but attempting to serialize this array:
```
[UdonSynced] private int[] votes = null;
```
Causes this error in `RequestSerialization`:

# Is it a bug?
... Well, the array was null. So I'm not surprised that something went wrong. But I don't think the entire Serialization is supposed to fail? The other synced variables failed to be serialized as well, until I fixed the issue my initializing the empty array.
